screens.title: Satchel
screens.description: A paper-backed inventory fragment keeps object drawings uneven, tactile, and easy to distinguish at a glance.

screens.title: Field Journal
screens.description: A rough two-column notebook pairs a brief observation with one hand-drawn landmark and keeps the linework legible.

screens.title: Alpine Trail Map
screens.description: Hatched ridges, contour rings, and a red-pencil trail communicate terrain and direction without a polished GIS panel.

limitations: Graphite texture and UI anatomy are original interpretations of the official hand-penciled premise, not captures or reconstructions of the game's screens.
All landscapes, objects, writing, and marks are original vector studies. No in-game scans, official artwork, or custom font files are included.
The specimens communicate visual rules only. Inventory behavior, journal persistence, map interaction, engine integration, and forward testing remain for later work.

componentCapture.scope: Parent-reviewed component rendering; independent full-screen usage follows.
